scope: This is the parity-correct algebraicity and transcendence endpoint. The auxiliary preΨ polynomial is insufficient at even indices, as the separately checked index-two obstruction shows. This claim does not prove the still-missing group-law implication that scalar torsion forces ΨSq to vanish, nor any subexponential ECDLP runtime theorem.
statement: For a Weierstrass curve over a constant field, a nonzero-index full squared division polynomial ΨSq cannot vanish at a nonzero constant multiple of a transcendental element in a field extension.
